title: 336 Steady Exposure
style: Japanese disco with crisp four-on-the-floor kick, syncopated bass guitar, shimmering synth marimba, and tight percussion; verse rides clipped talk-sung lines over spare groove, pre-chorus opens with filtered strings and rising claps, chorus hits with glossy stacked harmonies and chant hooks. Lead vocal stays close-mic with doubled lines on the hook, playful ad-libs panned wide, tape-stop flicks and reverse cymbal swells between sections, bright punchy mix with city-pop sheen., fake, steady, disco
